title: Motion for an extension of time within which to file the briefs on the merits

pages.text:
425 Third St. SW, Suite 800, Washington, DC 20024 • Tel: (202) 646-5172
FAX: (202) 646-5199 • Email: Rnobile@judicialwatch.org • www.JudicialWatch.org



       June 23, 2025

VIA Hand Delivery

The Honorable Scott S. Harris
Clerk of the Court
Supreme Court of the United States
One First Street NE
Washington, DC 20543

 Re:  Argument and Briefing Schedule in Bost, et al., v. Illinois State Board of Elections,
  et al., No. 24-568

Dear Mr. Harris,

 I represent the Petitioners in this case, which the Court granted certiorari on June 2, 2025.
Under Rule 25, Petitioners’ opening brief is due on July 17, 2025, and R espondents’ brief is due
on August 16, 2025. Counsel for both parties are discussing possible briefing schedules.  The Court
has not yet scheduled oral arguments.

 Counsel for Petitioners  and Respondents desire extensions for the ir respective opening
briefs.  To that end, Petitioners and Respondents jointly propose the following schedule:  The time
in which to file Petitioners’ brief would be extended to and including July 31, 2025, and the time
in which to file Respondents’ brief would be extend to and including September 12, 2025. Under
Rule 25.3, Petitioners’ reply brief would be due on October 13, 2025.

 This proposed briefing schedule would conclude the briefing more than ten days before the
argument provided it is scheduled for November 2025 or later. If argument is scheduled for
October 2025, Petitioners and Respondents jointly propose the following schedule:  The time in
which to file Petitioners’ brief would be extended to and including July 22, 2025, and the time in
which to file Respondents’ brief would be extended to and including August 26, 2025.  Under Rule
25.3, Petitioners’ reply brief would be due on September 25, 2025.

 If you have any further questions, please do not hesitate to contact me at
Rnobile@judicialwatch.org or at (202) 527-9866.

425 Third St. SW, Suite 800, Washington, DC 20024 • Tel: (228) 223-7820
Rnobile@JudicialWatch.org • www.JudicialWatch.org

Sincerely,


 s/ Russ Nobile
T. Russell Nobile
       Senior Attorney
Judicial Watch Inc.


cc  Jane Elinor Notz
 Counsel for Respondents
